title: Vibrant Korean-Style Dumplings with Crispy Tofu
description: A unique twist on traditional German cuisine, these vibrant Korean-style dumplings are filled with a tasty mixture of tofu and served with crispy tofu for a delicious and satisfying meal.

ingredients.name: tofu
ingredients.notes: firm, drained, and cut into small pieces

instructions: 1. In a pan, heat 1 tbsp of vibrant sesame oil over medium heat.
2. Add the tofu and cook until golden brown, about 5 minutes.
3. In a separate pan, cook the dumplings according to package instructions.
4. In a bowl, mix together chili flakes, soy sauce, sugar, and green onions.
5. Add the cooked dumplings to the bowl and toss to coat.
6. Add the crispy garlic to the bowl and toss to combine.
7. To assemble the dish, place a portion of the dumplings on a plate and top with crispy tofu.
8. Drizzle with remaining sesame oil and serve immediately.
